title: Equalized Generative Treatment: Matching f-divergences for Fairness in Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in generation quality and diversity between male and female groups by measuring difference in Topological Precision and Recall (TopP&R) and Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) for both image generation (FFHQ dataset, using a classifier oracle) and text generation (Wikipedia Biographies dataset, using a pronoun-based heuristic and text embeddings).
